privacy_policy.title: Personal Data We Collect
privacy_policy.content:
We collect information when you visit our website or make a purchase:

**Automatically Collected Information (Device Data):**
• Browser type, IP address, time zone, and device identifiers
• Pages viewed, referring URLs, and interaction patterns
• Cookies, log files, web beacons, tags, and pixels

**Information You Provide:**
• Name, billing and shipping address, email, and phone number
• Transaction details and communication records
• Payment information (processed through secure third-party gateways)

**Store Visit Data:**
• Store visit logs and CCTV footage for security purposes
• Feedback, survey responses, and customer support interactions

privacy_policy.title: How We Use Your Information
privacy_policy.content:
We use your personal information to:

• Process and fulfill orders placed through our website
• Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and delivery notifications
• Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
• Send promotional communications (with your consent)
• Improve our website functionality and user experience
• Detect and prevent fraudulent activities
• Comply with legal obligations and regulatory requirements

privacy_policy.title: Information Sharing and Disclosure
privacy_policy.content:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:

• **Service Providers:** Payment processors, shipping companies, and logistics partners
• **Professional Advisors:** Lawyers, accountants, and consultants
• **Law Enforcement:** When required by law or to protect our rights
• **Business Partners:** With your explicit consent

All third parties are contractually required to maintain confidentiality and use information only for specified purposes.

privacy_policy.title: Data Security and Protection
privacy_policy.content:
We implement comprehensive security measures:

• **Encryption:** SSL encryption for all data transmission
• **Secure Processing:** PCI-compliant payment processing partners
• **Access Controls:** Limited access on a need-to-know basis
• **Regular Audits:** Security assessments and system updates
• **Secure Storage:** Encrypted data storage with backup systems

privacy_policy.title: Your Rights and Choices
privacy_policy.content:
You have the right to:

• Access and review your personal information
• Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
• Request deletion of your account and personal data
• Opt-out of marketing communications
• Request a copy of your data in portable format
• Lodge complaints with supervisory authorities

To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@thesolitario.com

privacy_policy.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
privacy_policy.content:
We use cookies and similar technologies to:

• Remember your preferences and shopping cart contents
• Analyze website traffic and user behavior patterns
• Personalize your browsing experience
• Enable social media features and integrations

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect website functionality and your user experience.

privacy_policy.title: Data Retention and Updates
privacy_policy.content:
**Data Retention:**
We retain personal information as long as necessary to fulfill purposes outlined in this policy or as required by law.

**Policy Updates:**
We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated through:
• Email notifications to registered users
• Prominent notices on our website
• Updated "Last Modified" date on this page

We encourage regular review of this policy for any changes.

shipping_policy.title: Domestic Shipping (India)
shipping_policy.content:
**Free Shipping:** We offer FREE shipping on all orders within India

**Delivery Timeframes:**
• In-stock items: 48-72 hours
• Made-to-order items: Up to 25 business days

**Coverage:** All orders are fully insured during transit
**Inspection:** We encourage customers to inspect packages for damage before accepting delivery
**Fulfillment:** Shipments handled through trusted third-party courier and logistics partners

shipping_policy.title: International Shipping
shipping_policy.content:
We proudly ship to selected countries worldwide:

**Delivery Time:** 7-21 business days (depending on destination and customs)
**Shipping Charges:** Calculated at checkout based on weight, value, and destination
**Insurance:** All international shipments are fully insured
**Customs:** Customers responsible for applicable duties and import taxes
**Carriers:** Reliable international shipping partners ensure safe delivery

shipping_policy.title: Packaging and Presentation
shipping_policy.content:
**Secure Packaging:** Every item delivered in durable, tamper-proof packaging
**Exclusive Presentation:** All purchases arrive in exclusive Solitario boxes
**Certificates Included:** All relevant certificates and documentation included

**Free Gift Packaging:**
• Complimentary gift packaging for all gift orders
• Personalized gift messages included
• Distinctive Solitario gift presentation
• Memorable unboxing experience for recipients

shipping_policy.title: Delivery Requirements
shipping_policy.content:
**Signature Required:** All deliveries require signature upon receipt
**Address Accuracy:** Customers responsible for providing correct delivery addresses
**Availability:** Someone must be available to receive high-value packages
**Inspection Period:** Immediate inspection recommended upon delivery

shipping_policy.title: Policy Updates
shipping_policy.content:
We reserve the right to modify this shipping policy at any time:

• Changes take effect immediately upon posting
• Material updates will be communicated to customers
• Regular review recommended for current terms
• Contact customer service for clarifications on policy changes

return_policy.title: Exchange Policy
return_policy.content:
We offer exchanges on eligible jewellery items under these conditions:

**Timeline:** Exchange requests must be raised within 7 days of delivery

**Condition Requirements:**
• Item must be unused, unworn, and undamaged
• Returned in original condition with original packaging
• Original invoice and certificates must be included
• No signs of wear, alteration, damage, or tampering

**Restrictions:**
• Customized, engraved, or made-to-order items may not be eligible
• Price differences between exchanged items will be adjusted accordingly

**Required Documentation:**
• Original product and packaging
• Original or copy of invoice
• Product certificates (if applicable)
• Valid government ID proof
• Warranty card

return_policy.title: Buyback Policy
return_policy.content:
We offer buyback services on jewellery purchased from Solitario:

**Valuation Basis:**
• Current metal market value
• Gemstone valuation (if applicable)
• Applicable deductions per company policy

**Non-Recoverable Costs:**
• Making charges and craftsmanship fees
• Taxes and certification charges
• Shipping and handling costs

**Payment Options:**
• Store credit for future purchases
• Adjustment against new purchase
• Terms vary by product category

**Market Conditions:** Buyback values subject to prevailing market rates and brand-specific terms

return_policy.title: Refund Policy
return_policy.content:
**General Policy:** Cash refunds are not typically offered

**Exceptional Cases:**
• Refunds considered at company's sole discretion
• Eligible amounts processed after necessary deductions
• Payment method determined by company policy

**Non-Refundable Items:**
• Shipping and handling charges
• Taxes and certification fees
• Custom or personalized items (unless defective)

**Process Requirements:**
• All requests must be pre-approved by customer support
• Items sent without approval will not be accepted
• Company reserves right to inspect before approval

return_policy.title: Return Process
return_policy.content:
**Initiation:** Contact customer support before returning any item

**Contact Information:**
• Email: paymentdesk@thesolitario.com
• Include order number and reason for return

**Important Notes:**
• All decisions by company are final and binding
• Policy subject to modification without prior notice
• Shipping costs for returns are customer's responsibility

**Processing Time:** Approved returns processed within 5-7 business days after inspection
